# 3. The Factions (Lore & Core Identity)

Cards belong to one of four colored factions, representing different **methodologies**.

> **Two-axis identity.** Faction is *how you win*. **Crew** is *who you run with*.
> They are independent — one crew's members can span three factions.

---

## 🟥 Warmongers  ·  ⚠️ *draft, unreviewed*

To the Warmongers, the world is forged in violence and paid for in blood. They don't just fight; they conquer. Their bodies are meticulously honed to be ultimate weapons and unbreakable shields. Offensively they hit with the force of a freight train, overwhelming blockers and spilling raw physical destruction directly into the enemy line. Defensively they are masochistic guardians, throwing their massive frames into the line of fire to absorb blows meant for their crew, turning pain into permanent power. They don't scheme or play mind games -- they endure, they adapt, and they break you through sheer, unrelenting physical dominance.

> **The printed weakness:** *But when a problem cannot be solved with fists, and their unbreakable bodies finally begin to fail, what will they have left?*

## 🟦 Overthinkers  ·  ⚠️ *draft, unreviewed*

The Overthinkers view the battlefield as a chessboard, and everyone else is just a pawn waiting to be sacrificed. They rely on cold, calculating intellect, viewing physical brawling as the primitive flailing of animals. Offensively they bypass the body entirely, directly attacking your psyche and shattering your mental resolve from afar. Defensively they manipulate the flow of combat, forcing you to attack decoys, redirecting your strikes, or laying traps that violently punish your aggression. They hoard information, strip your hand of options, control the board state, and dictate exactly how and when you are allowed to breathe.

> **The printed weakness:** *But when their perfect plans are suddenly punched in the mouth, and the chaotic violence of the streets overwhelms their grand designs, how long can a genius survive a street fight?*

## 🟩 Assholes  ·  ⚠️ *draft, unreviewed*

Why play fair when playing dirty pays so much better? The Assholes don't care about honor, physical endurance, or intellectual supremacy -- they only care about winning by making you miserable. They are the ultimate opportunists. Offensively they bleed you dry, striking from the shadows where you can't hit back and extorting your hard-earned cards and resources. Defensively they don't block; they evade, slip past your defenses, or plant spies directly onto your side of the board to sabotage you from the inside out. They weaponize frustration, stealing your energy, hijacking your tempo, and laughing while your empire crumbles.

> **The printed weakness:** *But if they are ever dragged out of the shadows and forced into a fair, head-on collision, do they have the spine to survive it?*

## 🟨 Icons  ·  ⚠️ *draft, unreviewed*

The Icons do not fight for survival; they fight for the soul of the city. They are the pillars of the community, commanding absolute respect and ruling through a heavy, unbreakable aura of guilt and loyalty. Offensively they don't need to throw a single punch -- they win the cultural war, accumulating so much societal Influence that you simply cease to matter. Defensively they are the supreme caretakers, healing the broken, pacifying violence before a single punch is thrown, and crippling attackers by making them carry the immense shame of striking a legend. They are martyrs, sponsors, and untouchable kings.

> **The printed weakness:** *But if their followers are slaughtered, and their pristine image is violently dragged through the mud, can a symbol actually bleed?*
